Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: In the very first step, the WebSurfer failed to perform a critical fact-check. It accepted a hallucinated or incorrect search result from the search engine (which claimed the "English Electric Sertility" was a WWII aircraft) without verifying the historical timeline. The search results explicitly stated the aircraft first flew in 1949 and entered service in 1951, yet the WebSurfer immediately concluded it was the answer to the question about a WWII aircraft. This failure to validate the temporal consistency of the information led to the propagation of a false answer.
